Install splinterm on Omarchy

Persistent Wayland terminal for humans and bounded automation

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add splinterm
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.1.1-1:
    pacman -Qi splinterm

Open and use splinterm

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql splinterm

Frequently asked questions

How do I install splinterm on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add splinterm. The download is 8.4 MB and it takes 20.4 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is splinterm free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall splinterm?

Run omarchy pkg drop splinterm. It removes the package from your system.

What does splinterm depend on?

The package declares 13 dependencies: fontconfig, freetype2, gcc-libs, glibc, libxkbcommon, pixman, wayland, hicolor-icon-theme, noto-fonts-cjk, noto-fonts-emoji, python, ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is splinterm in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as splinterm (version 0.1.1-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. ministry-of-taste makes it. Project site: https://github.com/ministry-of-taste/splinterm.
